description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a team building detection models and products for fraud, identity, and trust-and-safety challenges. You will own technical problems end to end, from analyzing evidence to delivering tools that help fraud teams make informed decisions.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and ship detection models and the systems around them.

 - Evaluate model and system performance honestly, including documenting failure modes.

 - Work with trust and fraud teams to turn evidence into decisions and usable workflows.

 - Adapt systems as adversaries change their tactics.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Technical experience in at least one relevant area: computer vision or image forensics, speech or audio modeling, video or temporal analysis, ML infrastructure, evaluation or calibration, fraud, identity, trust and safety, or full-stack product engineering.

 - Experience owning a technical problem end to end and building and shipping detection models, supporting systems, or product experiences.

 - Ability to measure performance, identify failure modes, and iterate as conditions change.

 - Experience working with trust and fraud teams to translate evidence into decisions and product workflows.


LOCATION

Work arrangement was not specified. Primary location: New York, United States.
